tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Brand. The build-room ground (workshops, build nights, recaps) and all text on brand-ivory (17.6:1). Same in every theme.

tokens.name: brand-ivory
tokens.usage: Brand. The boardroom ground (speakers, partners, Open Floor) and all text on brand-black (17.6:1). Warmer than white so screen and print read as paper. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Brand. Sampled from the logo's spark. A mark, never a ground and never text on ivory (1.7:1). On graphics it appears only as the spark: in the logo plus at most one accent spark. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: brand-stone
tokens.usage: Brand. Secondary text on brand-ivory: deks, mono labels, captions (6.5:1).

tokens.name: brand-fog
tokens.usage: Brand. Secondary text on brand-black: deks, mono labels, captions (7.8:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background of the dashboard, site and documents.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, menus and inputs sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells, table stripes, the neutral tag fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk (15:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk (5.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. It carries no meaning, so it may sit under 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders, table rules that separate data (3:1 or better on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The spark mark in UI: the accent spark, active-tab underline, the selected-post marker. A fill, not text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: spark-text
tokens.usage: Gold when it has to be text: on surface (5.7:1) and spark-soft (5.4:1) in Paper; on surface and spark-soft (8.6:1) in Ink.

tokens.name: spark-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind spark-text, e.g. the Approved tag.

tokens.name: on-spark
tokens.usage: Text or icons on a spark fill (10.7:1). Never white on gold.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Posted, checks passed. Text on surface and surface-raised (5.8:1 or better). Always beside a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Style-check flags, failed exports. Text on surface and surface-raised (6.5:1 or better). Always beside a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Black on Paper, gold on Ink; 10:1 or better on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and slide titles. Sentence case.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Build a working app in 90 minutes
styles.usage: Section heads in the dashboard, docs and decks.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: We bring in the people deploying AI and host the arguments about it.
styles.usage: One-sentence deks under a headline, speaker bios. Never bold.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: The hard part was never the model. It was the data.
styles.usage: Pull quotes from speakers and members.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring a laptop. No experience needed.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Updated 2 hours ago by the marketing lead.
styles.usage: Secondary UI text, table cells, help text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Series labels, section kickers, tags. Always uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dates, times, rooms, counts, anything a reader scans.

styles.name: post-headline
styles.sample: Ship an AI tool before midnight
styles.usage: Headline on a 1080×1350 post, up to 8 words.

styles.name: post-headline-long
styles.sample: What a data center would actually mean for Wichita
styles.usage: Headline of 9 to 12 words. Longer than 12: rewrite it.

styles.name: post-dek
styles.sample: Two speakers, one moderator and your questions.
styles.usage: One sentence under the post headline, in brand-stone or brand-fog.

styles.name: post-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, data-strip labels and footers on a post. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label over value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones, list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop, gaps between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: post-margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on every social canvas and the pitch of the ledger grid. Nothing but the ground and grid crosses it.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every social graphic, photo crop and data strip. Graphics are square-cornered, like paper.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, small controls in the dashboard.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels and cards in the dashboard.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle switches only.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: UI dividers and table rules.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: The rules under a post's header and above its data strip, at 1080px.

tokens.name: stroke-grid
tokens.usage: Ledger grid lines and data-strip cell dividers on a post, at 6% and 22% opacity of the text color.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Dashboard dialogs and the floating preview only. Never on graphics.
